definitions.explanation: A style of writing that uses modern spoken Japanese grammar and vocabulary, as opposed to the classical literary style ({文語体|ぶんごたい}). In Japanese linguistics, this refers specifically to the modern language style that became standard after the Meiji-era language reforms.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口語体|こうごたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: This novel is written in colloquial style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口語体|こうごたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: Literature in the colloquial style spread during the Meiji period.

examples.japanese: {口語体|こうごたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{文語体|ぶんごたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Understanding the difference between colloquial and literary styles is important for studying the history of Japanese.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧ (spoken language) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (style/form). This is a key term in Japanese linguistics and literary history, referring to the writing style based on modern spoken Japanese.

ETYMOLOGY:
Before the Meiji period, written Japanese ({文語体|ぶんごたい}) was very different from spoken Japanese. The {言文一致|げんぶんいっち} (unification of speech and writing) movement in the late 19th century promoted writing in the same style as speech, leading to the dominance of {口語体|こうごたい} in modern Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口語体|こうごたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in colloquial style
- {口語体|こうごたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: colloquial-style writing
- {口語体|こうごたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{文語体|ぶんごたい}: colloquial and literary styles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文語体|ぶんごたい}: literary/classical style — the contrasting style based on classical Japanese grammar
- ⟦{口語|こうご}→口語：12033_kougo⟧: spoken language — the language itself, not the writing style
- ⟦{話し言葉|はなしことば}→話し言葉：23878_hanashikotoba⟧: spoken language — more everyday term, less technical
